lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 to 15 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in three primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a semi-regular equidistant spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a clearly defined grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features extend across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.
